title: HelperSessionAdoptLifecycleResult
description: The lifecycle launch this session's shell was spawned with, or null when the session is conventional. Null is an answer and is always present: a coordinator must be able to tell 'this session has no lifecycle channel' from 'this generation does not answer the question', because the first is a pane that is correct as it stands and the second is a degrade the product has to state.
